products.name: LG 574 L French door refrigerator with glass doors, Wi-Fi Convertible and Hygiene Fresh+
products.shortName: 574 L French door refrigerator, glass doors
products.summary: Open either fridge door and slide out the vegetable box, open the freezer, then stand it in your kitchen at its real size.
products.arTip: Tap a door to open it
products.sizeNote: With all four doors open, LG's manual gives 129 cm across and 105.7 cm deep
specs: French door (LG: Multi Door): two fridge doors over two freezer doors, no handles
Smart Inverter (BLDC); 1 year on the product, 9 more years on the compressor
Door Cooling+, LINEAR Cooling, Hygiene Fresh+
Select Meat, Fish or Vegetables on the control panel and it adjusts the temperature
2 separate vegetable boxes in the fridge
6 in the fridge, transparent; none in the freezer
Normal ice tray; no dispenser, no automatic ice maker
Internal LED display, Express Freeze, door alarm
Glass in Black Mirror; steel in Prime Silver
Top LED in the fridge and the freezer

hotspots.title: Door Cooling+
hotspots.text: Delivers faster and even cooling to areas where cold air is easily lost, helping keep food fresher for longer.

hotspots.title: Fresh Converter+
hotspots.text: Using the I-Micom control panel, simply select Meat, Fish, or Vegetables, and it intelligently adjusts the temperature to suit each ingredient, keeping them fresh, tasty, and ready to cook.

hotspots.title: 2 Separate Boxes
hotspots.text: Store ingredients into two different boxes for longer shelf life and easier access.

hotspots.title: Smart Inverter Compressor
hotspots.text: Smart Inverter Compressor technology for enhanced energy efficiency and bigger savings. Enjoy ultra-quiet performance backed by a 10-year warranty.

fit.note: From LG's owner's manual: allow over 5 cm between the back and the wall. The manual gives 105.7 cm of depth with the doors open, which is 32.1 cm in front of the fridge, and 129 cm across with the doors open.
